bank.name: One-Word Substitution
bank.subject: English
bank.description: Choose the single word that best replaces the given phrase.

questions.prompt: One who speaks many languages:
questions.explanation: A polyglot is a person who speaks many languages.

questions.prompt: A person who writes books:
questions.explanation: An author is a person who writes books.

questions.prompt: A person who cannot read or write:
questions.explanation: Illiterate means unable to read or write.

questions.prompt: A place where bees are kept:
questions.explanation: An apiary is a place where bees are kept; an aviary is for birds.

questions.prompt: The study of stars and planets:
questions.explanation: Astronomy is the study of stars, planets and the universe.

questions.prompt: A person who is present everywhere:
questions.explanation: Omnipresent means present everywhere at the same time.

questions.prompt: Something that cannot be avoided:
questions.explanation: Inevitable means certain to happen and unavoidable.

questions.prompt: A person who loves his country and works for it:
questions.explanation: A patriot is a person who loves and supports his country.

questions.prompt: A medicine that kills germs:
questions.explanation: An antibiotic is a medicine that kills or inhibits bacteria and germs.

questions.prompt: Government by the people:
questions.explanation: Democracy is government by the people, through elected representatives.

questions.prompt: A person who looks on the bright side of things:
questions.explanation: An optimist always expects good outcomes and sees the bright side.

questions.prompt: A statement that can be understood in two ways:
questions.explanation: Ambiguous means open to more than one interpretation.

questions.prompt: A person who does not believe in God:
questions.explanation: An atheist is a person who does not believe in the existence of God.

questions.prompt: The science of the origin and development of the universe:
questions.explanation: Cosmology is the study of the origin and development of the universe.

questions.prompt: That which cannot be conquered:
questions.explanation: Invincible means too powerful to be defeated or conquered.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who can speak several languages':
questions.explanation: A polyglot speaks many languages; a linguist studies languages.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who loves mankind and works for its welfare':
questions.explanation: A philanthropist promotes the welfare of others, often through donations.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a government by the wealthy':
questions.explanation: Plutocracy is rule by the wealthy; aristocracy is rule by the nobility.

questions.prompt: One word for 'something that cannot be corrected':
questions.explanation: Incorrigible means beyond correction or reform.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a place where wine is made':
questions.explanation: A winery is where wine is produced; a brewery makes beer.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the study of human population':
questions.explanation: Demography is the statistical study of human populations.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who is indifferent to pleasure or pain':
questions.explanation: A stoic endures hardship without showing emotion.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the murder of a brother':
questions.explanation: Fratricide is the killing of a brother; regicide the killing of a king.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who never makes mistakes':
questions.explanation: Infallible means incapable of making mistakes.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a book written about one's own life':
questions.explanation: An autobiography is an account of a person's life written by that person.

questions.prompt: One word for 'fear of confined spaces':
questions.explanation: Claustrophobia is the fear of enclosed spaces; acrophobia of heights.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who studies the origins and customs of ancient peoples':
questions.explanation: An archaeologist studies ancient human societies through artefacts and remains.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the study of the origins and history of words':
questions.explanation: Etymology studies the origin and development of words.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who believes in the existence of God':
questions.explanation: A theist believes in God; an atheist does not; an agnostic is unsure.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a place where weapons and ammunition are stored':
questions.explanation: An arsenal is a storehouse for weapons and ammunition.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person appointed to settle disputes':
questions.explanation: An arbitrator settles disputes between parties.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a speech in a play delivered by one character alone':
questions.explanation: A soliloquy is a speech spoken by a character alone on stage.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a government by officials':
questions.explanation: Bureaucracy is rule by administrative officials.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who loves books':
questions.explanation: A bibliophile loves or collects books.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the study of birds':
questions.explanation: Ornithology is the scientific study of birds.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who is very fond of pleasure and luxury':
questions.explanation: An epicurean is devoted to the pursuit of pleasure and luxury.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who withdraws from the world to live in solitude':
questions.explanation: A hermit lives alone, away from society, often for religious reasons.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a collection of maps':
questions.explanation: An atlas is a book of maps.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the art of public speaking':
questions.explanation: Oratory is the art of skilled, persuasive public speaking.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a disease that spreads rapidly among many people':
questions.explanation: An epidemic spreads rapidly within a community; a pandemic is worldwide.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who writes for newspapers or magazines':
questions.explanation: A journalist writes news reports for publications.

questions.prompt: One word for 'to speak ill of someone behind their back':
questions.explanation: Defame means to damage someone's reputation with false statements.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a government ruled by women':
questions.explanation: Gynocracy (gynecocracy) is government by women.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who is easily deceived':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who withdraws money from a bank by cheque':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who studies the weather':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a doctor who treats children':
questions.explanation: A paediatrician specialises in the care of children.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a statement that is obviously true and says nothing new':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who talks too much':
questions.explanation: Loquacious means very talkative.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a place where coins are manufactured':
questions.explanation: A mint is where coins are produced.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the study of the universe and celestial bodies':
questions.explanation: Astronomy is the scientific study of celestial objects.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who settles in another country':
questions.explanation: An immigrant is someone who comes to live permanently in another country.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a formal written request to an authority':
questions.explanation: A petition is a formal written request.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the killing of a large number of people':
questions.explanation: A massacre is the brutal killing of many people.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who believes that all events are predetermined':
questions.explanation: A fatalist believes fate decides everything.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a roundabout way of saying something':
questions.explanation: Circumlocution is indirect or roundabout speech.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who is appointed to audit accounts':
questions.explanation: An auditor examines and verifies financial accounts.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a disease that spreads by contact':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who lives in a foreign country':
questions.explanation: An expatriate lives outside their native country.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who thinks only of himself':
questions.explanation: An egoist is concerned chiefly with their own interests.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a place where books are kept':
questions.explanation: A library is a place where books are collected and read.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the study of ancient life through fossils':
questions.explanation: Palaeontology studies fossil remains of ancient life.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who makes or repairs shoes':
questions.explanation: A cobbler mends or makes shoes.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a formal speech praising a dead person':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who writes his own biography':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a temporary suspension of hostilities':
questions.explanation: A truce is an agreed temporary stop to fighting.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who studies maps and mapmaking':
questions.explanation: A cartographer draws and studies maps.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the sound made by a lion':
questions.explanation: A lion roars.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a place where goods are stored':
questions.explanation: A warehouse is a large building for storing goods.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who is always cheerful':
questions.explanation: An optimist always looks on the bright side.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who makes maps of the sky or studies stars':
questions.explanation: An astronomer scientifically studies stars and celestial bodies.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the study of human diseases and their treatment':
questions.explanation: Pathology is the study of disease.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who writes letters or official documents for others':
questions.explanation: A scribe copies or writes documents professionally.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a place where airplanes are kept and repaired':
questions.explanation: A hangar is a large building housing aircraft.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who is easily frightened':
questions.explanation: Timid means easily scared or shy.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a story that is not true':
questions.explanation: Fiction is invented or untrue narrative.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the study of the mind and behaviour':
questions.explanation: Psychology is the science of mind and behaviour.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who is trained to travel in space':
questions.explanation: An astronaut is a space traveller.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a formal farewell ceremony for the dead':
questions.explanation: A funeral is the ceremony for burying or cremating the dead.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a place where animals are kept for study or display':
questions.explanation: A zoo (zoological garden) keeps animals for display.

questions.prompt: One word for 'the art of beautiful handwriting':
questions.explanation: Calligraphy is the art of decorative handwriting.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who foretells the future':
questions.explanation: A prophet foretells future events by divine inspiration.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a group of ships sailing together':
questions.explanation: A fleet is a group of ships operating together.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a remedy for all diseases':
questions.explanation: A panacea is a universal remedy for all ills.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who is hard to please':

questions.prompt: One word for 'an official stop of fighting':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who eats too much':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a list of books and writings':

questions.prompt: One word for 'the killing of a king':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who lives alone':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a book written by hand':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who has no money':

questions.prompt: One word for 'the murder of one's mother':

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who studies human societies':
questions.explanation: An anthropologist studies human societies and cultures.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a place where weapons are stored':

questions.explanation: A wardrobe is a cupboard for storing clothes.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who can use both hands equally well':
questions.explanation: An ambidextrous person uses both hands with equal skill.

questions.explanation: An epitaph is an inscription on a tomb in memory of the dead.

questions.prompt: One word for 'a person who has thorough knowledge of a subject':
questions.explanation: An authority is an expert with thorough knowledge of a subject.

questions.prompt: One word for 'an imaginary ideal society':
questions.explanation: A utopia is an imaginary perfect society.
